a.lede: The president cited the U.S. attorney general in defending Huang's return, while urging Nvidia to continue its export-control investigation.
a.title: Trump endorses Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia, says US has no evidence of wrongdoing

b.lede: Jensen Huang returned to the office after being reinstated to CEO to cheers, according to videos spread on social media.
b.title: Jensen Huang returns to applause from employees at Nvidia HQ
